requirements.quote: Every service ships structured JSON logs with `service`, `env`, `request_id`, `workspace_id` (id only), `level` and trace ids; Caddy logs join the same pipeline [type:api]

A log redaction layer removes content fields (`body`, `text`, `title`, `filename`, `email`, `token`, `authorization`) and a test fails when a log line in the e2e run contains seeded privileged strings [type:api]
requirements.why: In-lane: redact.ts + seeded-string vitest and log-sink leak test; the full e2e-run capture is wired into the existing e2e workflow in CI.

requirements.quote: Loki retention is configured to at least 180 days and logs are stored on India infrastructure; a config test fails if retention is below 4320 hours or the storage endpoint is outside India [type:unit]
`verify-retention.sh` proves logs older than 170 days still exist after a time-travel test fixture and that compaction does not delete earlier [type:api]
Host and containers use NTP-synchronised time; an alert fires when clock drift exceeds 1 s, satisfying CERT-In timestamp expectations [type:api]

Alert rules exist and are promtool-tested for: service down (5 minutes), `/readyz` failing, p95 latency above 400 ms for 10 minutes, DB CPU above 60% for 15 minutes, disk above 80%, queue lag above threshold, dead-letter growth, backup stale (WAL age above 5 minutes, base backup above 26 hours), restore drill failed, certificate expiring in 14 days, error rate spike [type:unit]
requirements.evidence: promtool test rules runs in CI via the pinned prom/prometheus image (promtool not installed locally); in-lane node test checks every alert name has a test case

requirements.quote: Court-day windows (07:00 to 10:30 and 18:00 to 23:00 IST) have stricter alert thresholds and a dedicated dashboard; alert rules use IST-aware time-of-day muting only to reduce noise, never to silence P0 [type:unit]
Alertmanager routes P0 and P1 to the on-call receiver configured by env and to a fallback receiver; a synthetic alert test proves delivery through the console or webhook mock in CI [type:api]
requirements.evidence: CI synthetic-alert step with amtool + webhook mock; in-lane node test checks route/receiver wiring

requirements.quote: Sentry integration remains optional: absent DSN the stack runs, with the DSN from the human issue enabling error reporting; scrubbing rules remove personal and matter data before send [type:unit]
Grafana dashboards are provisioned as code; Grafana is reachable only through the admin gate, not publicly [type:api]
Adapter health metrics (`adapter_parse_success_ratio`, `adapter_last_success_timestamp`) are exposed and feed the public status page in #96 [type:api]
requirements.why: Delivers metric helper, Prometheus rules and status-feed recording rules; wiring into concrete court adapters is out of scope here (instrumentation owned by adapter issues; #96 was closed not_planned).

requirements.quote: Monitoring resource use is bounded (documented limits) and fits the Stage A VPS cost target [type:manual]
Disk and retention growth model is documented with a projection for 1,000 seats so Stage B storage planning is possible [type:manual]

decisions.choice: Log fields renamed/added as snake_case request_id, workspace_id, trace_id, span_id alongside existing camelCase kept for one release
decisions.justification: Issue AC names snake_case; logger.ts:116-123 currently emits camelCase and existing consumers/tests may read it

decisions.choice: promtool cases live in prometheus/tests/*.yml, run in CI via the pinned prom image; local tests are static node tests
decisions.justification: promtool not installed on the host and images must not be pulled locally; precedent infra/scripts/compose-dev.test.mjs static checks

decisions.choice: Separate compose.monitoring.yml joined to an external monitoring network instead of editing compose.prod.yml
decisions.justification: Issue lists infra/monitoring/compose.monitoring.yml; keeps compose-prod.test.mjs invariants (only caddy publishes ports) intact

decisions.choice: OTel collector accepts OTLP gRPC and HTTP
decisions.justification: Issue specifies gRPC; apps export via HTTP (packages/observability/src/otel.ts uses exporter-*-otlp-http)
